title: AirRace (Boardgame)
description: A fun project to get started and learn basic programming principles. It is a boardgame style game with a animated GUI. An extra restriction of the project was to not use OOP.

title: Chess
description: A Chess application with working GUI and custom animations. I also developed a custom GUI API ontop of PyGame to help me with this project.

title: Braille Translater
description: This project translates a special form of braile into human readable text, and vica cerva. Furthermore it also uses a form of finite autometa to translate contractions or words into special braille characters.

title: Compiler
description: A compiler of a made up programming language that includes most of the normal components of modern programming languages. It compiles into JVM language that then runs with the normal JVM.

title: Messaging App
description: Exploring socket technology with different protocols and packet types over a local network. This project streched over 4 programs; two of wich are messaging, file transfer and voice calls.
